images.filename: Kulapi Stream during heavy downpour, Porgera, Enga Province.gif
images.caption: This small stream is know to remove drainage structures established by PJV(Barrick). Most of the stream run over calcareous rocks composed of limestone. During periods of prolonged downpours, these stream become powerful taking everything along it path. It is common of streams flowing in the Porgera Valley of Enga Province, Papua New Guinea

images.caption: This site is the location where crushed material which are unusable are dumped here where the photo was taken. Blasted Quarry limestone is extracted from the Quarry which is far ahead, where the Benches are clearly seen. This location is North West of Paiam station in Porgera District of Enga Province. The towers of the Lime processing plant can be seen in the mid-ground. Lime from the plant is extracted from the mined limestone which is crushed and pulverized. The final product is sent to Porgera Mine Mill for its metallurgical process in extracting Gold.
